subject: SOC2 / IR runbook evidence request — telemetry sample needed
messages:
From: Ian Brooks <ian.b@brightpark.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@brightpark.com
Cc: security-team@brightpark.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 evidence + IR runbook for procurement

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week — BrightPark procurement is moving this along to the security review. We have two asks to complete our internal checklist so we can sign the contract:

1) A copy of your incident response plan (IRP) and a brief write-up of who is on-call and escalation paths (SOC2 point).
2) A telemetry sample/export covering a 24-hour window (UTC) showing authentication events, API request traces (request id + timestamp), and any KV cache invalidation logs for the period. We only need metadata, not PII.

Timeline: procurement hopes to close by May 10; security would like material by EOD May 4 to run through with their engineers. Can you confirm whether you can provide the IRP and a sanitized telemetry snapshot by then? Also tell us the delivery format (CSV/NDJSON) and whether there's a manifest.

Thanks —
Ian Brooks
Director, IT Security
BrightPark
ian.b@brightpark.com

Attachments: none
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ian Brooks <ian.b@brightpark.com>, procurement@brightpark.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence + IR runbook for procurement

Ian — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can do this. Quick answers up front:

- IRP: yes, we will share a redacted IR runbook PDF and a short on-call escalation diagram.
- Telemetry export: we can provide a sanitized NDJSON/CSV package + manifest. Typical package includes auth logs, request traces (request_id, path, status, latency_ms, model), and control-plane events (cache invalidations, rollouts).

A couple of clarifying items so we prepare exactly what you need:
- Which 24-hour UTC window should we extract? If you don't specify, we'll send a representative window from last week (2027-04-24 00:00:00Z -> 2027-04-24 23:59:59Z).
- Do you require SSO provider raw tokens/audit logs or just authentication metadata (user id, timestamp, provider, success/fail)?

I'll include Marissa from Security and Karthik from Infrastructure to pull the artifacts. We aim to deliver the IRP and a first telemetry snapshot by EOD May 4. If you need it sooner, tell us the window and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ian Brooks <ian.b@brightpark.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence + IR runbook for procurement

Ian / team,

Attaching the current IRP and our SOC2 control mapping for your review. High level summary below so you can fast-track to the right section:

- redwood_IRP_v2.pdf: full runbook with playbook steps, communications templates, and retention/forensics policy (redacted customer-identifying fields). See section 3 for on-call roster escalation matrix.
- soc2_control_mapping_v1.xlsx: mapping of SOC2 CC and Redwood controls, where evidence lives (Drive path or SIEM exports).

For the telemetry package we plan to deliver:
- Format: NDJSON (newline JSON) with a CSV manifest for quick ingestion.
- Window: we'll prepare the representative window Alex suggested (2027-04-24T00:00:00Z -> 2027-04-24T23:59:59Z). If BrightPark prefers a different date, tell us by EOD May 3.
- Contents (sanitized): authentication metadata (user_id pseudonymized, timestamp, provider, result), API traces (request_id, route, status_code, latency_ms, model_id), control-plane events (cache_invalidation, deploys). No raw request payloads or PII will be included.

Delivery options: secure S3 presigned link (preferred) or secure Drive share. We'll include a small manifest CSV and a forensics-readme.txt describing field names and pseudonymization approach.

Link to the base evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1_example_shared_drive

If that aligns, we'll schedule a 30-minute drop-in with your security engineers on May 4 to walk through the artifacts.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_IRP_v2.pdf, soc2_control_mapping_v1.xlsx
From: Ian Brooks <ian.b@brightpark.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpark.com, security-team@brightpark.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence + IR runbook for procurement

Thanks Marissa — this looks like the right level of detail. A couple of follow-ups from our engineers: 

- Please include SSO provider audit_event_id in the auth export if possible (we can map to our SSO logs). We understand pseudonymization constraints; even a hashed user_id is fine.
- We also need a short sample (10 rows) of the API traces and the manifest ahead of the full package so our parsers can be validated.

We'd like the sample by EOD May 4 and the full telemetry package by EOD May 6. Procurement can still target May 10 if the artifacts validate.

Ian
Director, IT Security
BrightPark

Ian — attaching the small sample you requested plus the manifest. See notes below.

Attachments included in this thread:
- telemetry-snapshot-20270502.tar.gz (contains sample_auth.ndjson, sample_api_traces.ndjson)
- forensic-s3-manifest.csv (lists object keys, sizes, checksums)

Delivery notes and answers to your asks:
- user_id is pseudonymized with a consistent salted HMAC across the export so you can correlate without revealing raw IDs. We included auth_event_id where available.
- Sample contains 10 API trace rows and 10 auth rows (NDJSON). Field names are in the manifest and in the forensics-readme.txt inside the tarball.
- We provided a presigned S3 link (valid 7 days) in the Drive folder for the full package; if you want direct S3 delivery or a signed transfer agreement, let us know.

Next steps:
- If the sample validates your parsers, we'll push the full 24-hour export to the presigned link tonight.
- I'll schedule the 30-min walkthrough with your security engineers for Wed May 5 at 10:00 AM PT unless you prefer another time.

Thanks — appreciate the clear requirements.

Alex Martinez
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
